items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And who did I meet but Hank Duncan. And he was glad to see me.

ctx.x: Well Zutty fired him and he came home and told me and said, well I let Hank go, I told him, I fired him tonight, I can't stand him no more. I said, you give him a two weeks notice? No, I told him don't come to work tomorrow night. I said, well you can't do that Zutty, you have to give him two weeks notice.

Well I did; shoot, I got my clothes on and went down to the union because I was going to pay the tax for the band anyway. I paid the tax every week for the band. And who did I meet but Hank Duncan. And he was glad to see me. He said I just put in charges against Zutty because he didn't give me two weeks notice. I said, oh no, you come to work tonight. I said, we changed that. I said no, I said you just be on the job tonight I said, because he didn't mean it, I said. So you don't have to file any charges. And he…

And I came home and told Zutty. I said, you see, God works in a mysterious way. He was putting in charges and Zutty would have had to pay him for the two weeks whether he worked or not. And he had the charges released and he went to work the next night. I think that's when you, I don't know who was brought in.
